rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. There is no clear authentication step before acting. The agent executed order-changing writes (two cancellations and a return) without first confirming with the user. The user’s special condition about keeping the boots unless an identical, cheaper pair is available for exchange was not handled—no price check or exchange attempt is shown, and the returned item list could even include the boots. The agent also only looked up one of the user’s two emails, risking missing other orders. Finally, the agent did not provide the requested final outcome of how much money the user would get back today. These issues violate the pass criteria.
